sources.title: RemoteCLIP: A Vision Language Foundation Model for Remote Sensing
sources.snippet: The first vision-language foundation model for remote sensing: We propose a novel vision-language foundation model called RemoteCLIP. With the large-scale pretraining dataset, this model is trained to align vision-language representations and learns robust visual features with rich semantics of satellite imagery visual concepts.
